title: CAMERA app: preview, photos, timer, mirror and controls (manual until automated)

clauses.text: The CAMERA app shows a live preview, and a photo is saved as a JPEG in Pictures with a flash and a strip of recent shots.

steps.do: Open the CAMERA app, choose the camera, and take a photo with the photo control.
steps.expect: The screen flashes, the photo appears in the strip of recent shots, and a JPEG is in Pictures.

clauses.text: A recent shot opens in a viewer.

steps.do: Click a shot in the strip.
steps.expect: A larger view of the photo opens.

clauses.text: A 3 or 10 second timer counts down before the shot, and Esc cancels it.

steps.do: Choose the 10 second timer, start it, then press Esc during the count.
steps.expect: The count shows the seconds, and Esc cancels it before any photo is taken.

clauses.text: The mirror switch flips the picture, and brightness and contrast change it where the camera has them.

steps.do: Turn mirror on and off. Move brightness and contrast.
steps.expect: The picture flips left and right. Brightness and contrast change it. A camera without these controls shows no change.

clauses.text: The camera picker and the picture-size picker change the camera and its size.

steps.do: Choose another camera (if you have two) and another picture size.
steps.expect: The preview switches to that camera and size.

clauses.text: The app follows a USB camera being unplugged and plugged back in.

steps.do: Unplug the USB camera while the app shows it, then plug it back in.
steps.expect: The app shows that the camera is gone, and the picture comes back after it is plugged in.

clauses.text: The preview runs smoothly with natural colours (not yet checked on real hardware).

steps.do: Watch the preview for a minute at its default size.
steps.expect: Colours look natural and motion is smooth. Note any stutter or wrong colour, and the size you used.
